mapper.select: SELECT meal_feedback_id AS mealFeedbackId, content AS content, created_at AS createdAt, meal_id AS mealId, group_member_id AS groupMemberId FROM meal_feedback

SELECT meal_feedback_id AS mealFeedbackId, content AS content, created_at AS createdAt, meal_id AS mealId, group_member_id AS groupMemberId FROM meal_feedback WHERE meal_feedback_id = #{mealFeedbackId}

SELECT f.meal_feedback_id AS feedbackId, f.content AS content, f.created_at AS createdAt, u.user_id AS writerUserId, u.name AS writerName, m.role AS writerRole FROM meal_feedback f JOIN group_member m ON f.group_member_id = m.group_member_id JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.meal_id = #{mealId} AND m.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY f.created_at ASC
